    Printed daily by the State of Iowa during the sessions of the General Assembly. An
 official corrected copy is available for reference in the Secretary of the Senate’s Office.
 (The official bound copy will be available after a reasonable time upon adjournment.)

1st Day                     TUESDAY, OCTOBER 5, 2021                               1157

                JOURNAL OF THE SENATE

                              FIRST CALENDAR DAY
                               FIRST SESSION DAY
                            EXTRAORDINARY SESSION

                                  Senate Chamber
                     Des Moines, Iowa, Tuesday, October 5, 2021

   Pursuant to the proclamation of the Governor, the Honorable Kim
Reynolds, convening the Eighty-Ninth General Assembly in
Extraordinary Session, the Senate was called to order at 10:05 a.m. by
the Honorable Jake Chapman, President of the Senate.

[...]

                          FINAL ADJOURNMENT

  By virtue of Senate Concurrent Resolution 8, duly adopted,
President Chapman declared the 2021 Extraordinary Session of the
Eighty-Ninth General Assembly adjourned sine die.
